about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a software engineer with more than three years of experience as a full-stack developer. I design, build, and deploy robust, scalable web applications, and I take great pride in leading projects from start to finish—from conception to production release.

backend.title: Backend
backend.body: I specialize in backend development with PHP (Laravel v7–v12 and Livewire), JavaScript, and Python, applying MVC patterns, SOLID principles, and agile methodologies.

frontend.title: Frontend & SPA
frontend.body: I have experience building frontend projects, landing pages, and single-page applications (SPAs) using Tailwind CSS, React, and Next.js.

database.title: Databases
database.body: I have extensive experience modeling, normalizing, and optimizing MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.body: Additionally, I have successfully developed mobile applications with Flutter and React Native.

about.closing: My professional passion centers on leadership, teamwork, organization, and attention to detail. I am committed to continuous learning of new tools and techniques in web development.
